reading.body:
AI presentation software has consolidated around a small set of vendors, with six of seven tools based in the US, suggesting the category is maturing under American product leadership.

Presentation generation is now a commodity feature across this category. Every tool listed converts input into slide decks through automation. The differentiators are narrow: Decktopus adds data handling capabilities, Pitch.com emphasizes collaboration and EU hosting, Presentations.AI highlights brand governance, and Tome frames its output as narrative design rather than mere layout. These distinctions matter little to the underlying compute requirement, which is modest for this task relative to other AI workloads.

The absence of data about compute intensity, hosting location, or power consumption limits what this category reveals about AI infrastructure. Presentation generation runs on endpoints or cloud instances that need far less power than training or inference for language models. This category does not represent a meaningful load on the electrical grid that constrains AI scaling. It serves instead as a marker of where AI tooling has become routine enough to be packaged as consumer software.
